scientific_integrity: Analytical proof; finite numerical tests supplemental. No independent validation or publication priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two noiseless nonadaptive point observations of a known centered unit-variance stationary real OU process; the target is integrated squared path energy.
Every finite-horizon optimum is centered and strictly interior, and its gap solves an explicit one-variable global optimization; uniqueness of the finite-horizon gap is not claimed.
The unique long-horizon universal dimensionless separation is proved, but no noise, adaptive, higher-dimensional or unknown-parameter extension is claimed.
Publication priority against unindexed or inaccessible literature remains independently unconfirmed.
title: Centered two-sample design for stationary Ornstein–Uhlenbeck quadratic path energy
